newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PAG TO ACQUIRE 90 PCT IN ASSURANCE FIRM.
newsitem.headline: PAG TO ACQUIRE 90 PCT IN ASSURANCE FIRM.

text.p: Financial services group PAG Ltd said on Monday it would acquire not less than 90 percent of Anchor Life Assurance Company's 2.8 million ordinary shares issued from January 1 1997.
The group said in a statement it would also acquire the entire issued preference share capital for 15.50 rand per ordinary share in Anchor Life.
The purchase consideration payable for the entire Anchor Life would be 43.95 million rand.
PAG said the deal was being funded by the placement of 11.88 million shares with a number of major institutions and other third parties at 3.70 rand per share.
PAG director Chris Otto said Anchor Life policyholders would benefit from the acquisition through the expertise of PAG associated companies, Professional Securities Ltd and PSG Asset Management Ltd.
He said Anchor Life had been in operation for more than 25 years and its main area of operation had been in previously disadvantaged South African communities.
